Manage / Edit Jianying/Capcut drafts.

AGENT QUICKSTART (driving this as an agent? start here):
  Browse commands:  lyra-cli <domain> --help

USAGE:
  lyra-cli <domain> <[subdomain] ...> <action> [--flags] [--options]


OPTIONS:
  -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit
  -v,     --version           Show version information and exit.
          --jq TEXT           Pretty-print JSON output; with an optional selector like
                              .result.items[0].id, output the selected JSON value instead of
                              the full schema envelope.

SUBCOMMANDS:
  project                     Manage draft projects (create / list / focus / ...).
  cover                       Set or clear the draft cover
  extract                     Read draft structure information as JSON (read-only).
  template                    Add, inspect, and replace draft template packages in a draft.
  algo                        Draft algorithm capabilities.
  history                     Undo or redo the most recent draft edits.
  deform                      Apply high-level deformation intent using existing edit/algo
                              capabilities.
  edit                        FROZEN LEGACY RAW COMPATIBILITY FOR EXISTING INTEGRATIONS.
                              This surface no longer evolves. New Agent edits must use typed
                              `draft <domain> ...` commands.
                              
                              ACTIONS:
                              --remove [expr] Remove segment(s) or segment properties
                              --add <expr> Add segment(s) to draft
                              --move <expr> Move target segment(s)
                              --update <expr> Update properties of target segment(s)
                              --op <name> Run split / duplicate / freeze_frame / extract_frames
                              / extract_music / group / ungroup
                              --params <expr> Parameters for --op
                              --target <selector> Select target segment(s) for current action
                              --scope <expr> Select sub-range/object within target(s)
                              
                              COMBINATION RULES:
                              --remove must be used alone with --target
                              --op must be used alone with --params/--target optional
                              others can be chained: add/update/move
  video                       video shortcuts.
  sticker                     sticker shortcuts.
  text                        text shortcuts.
  text-template               text-template shortcuts.
  audio                       audio shortcuts.
  segment                     segment shortcuts.
  timeline                    timeline shortcuts.
  compound-clip               compound-clip shortcuts.
  filter                      filter shortcuts.
  effect                      effect shortcuts.
  adjust                      adjust shortcuts.
  subtitle                    subtitle shortcuts.
  lyrics                      lyrics shortcuts.
  keyframe                    keyframe shortcuts.
  config                      Configure draft-level settings (no target).
  blueprint                   Manage declarative draft blueprints.

EXAMPLES
  $ lyra-cli draft project create --ref local://example
  $ lyra-cli draft project focus --ref local://example
  $ lyra-cli draft config --ref local://example --ratio 16:9
  $ lyra-cli draft video add --ref local://example --resource local:///xx/yy/test.mp4
  $ lyra-cli draft extract summary --ref local://example

  $ lyra-cli draft --ref local://example --action video alpha --seg-id v1 --alpha 80% --action text style --seg-id t1 --color '#FFFFFF'

ACTION CHAINING
  Same object, shared target:
    lyra-cli draft video --seg-id v1 --action alpha --alpha 80% --action scale --scale 1.2
  Same object, per-block targets:
    lyra-cli draft video --action alpha --seg-id v1 --alpha 80% --action scale --seg-id v2 --scale 1.2
  Cross object, per-block targets:
    lyra-cli draft --action video alpha --seg-id v1 --alpha 80% --action text style --seg-id t1 --color '#FFFFFF'
  Public selectors:
    --seg-id, --seg-type, --target-track, --seg-index, --time-window
  Shared and per-block targets cannot be mixed. Shortcut paths use spaces, not dots.

LEARN MORE
  Use `lyra-cli draft <subcommand> --help` for more information.
